title: Geometric Structure of Bell Correlations in Bohmian Mechanics: A Configuration-Space Analysis of EPR Experiments
summary: We develop an explicit configuration-space formulation of EPR-Bell experiments within the framework of de Broglie-Bohm theory, in which joint measurement outcomes arise from a deterministic mapping from initial particle configurations to outcome pairs. This construction induces a partition of the hidden-variable configuration space into domains associated with the different measurement outcomes.
